'''Interdimensional travel''' was a hypothetical method of travel to other dimensions. As of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Era/Legends|era]], this form of travel was unheard of, and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Plikk]] investigated a curious dimensional rift in hopes of achieving this phenomenon, in order to curry favor with the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]].<ref name="marvel46">[[Star Wars (1977) 46|''Star Wars'' (1977) 46]]</ref>
